text:
elaine: Heads up — release cut blocked by smoke-suite failures against Hosted API. Failures are auth + streaming + toolcall related on shard 17. Need quick triage, trying not to hold the cut.
sam: Can you paste the job link/logs?
elaine: https://ci.redwood.example/runs/98765 — lots of 401s from /v1/toolcall plus streaming connections aborted. Local run passes.
ci-bot: Job 98765 failed: tools/toolcall_integration_shard17 — 401 Unauthorized (x10), streaming aborted, test timeout 30s.
priya: I can take this. Any deploys or token rotations around 06:10–06:20 UTC?
mike: We rolled auth key rotation at 06:12 UTC this morning. @sam did the rollout finish cleanly?
sam: Rollout finished 06:13:10, no errors reported in rollout logs.
elaine: Test snippets show a kid mismatch on introspect then 401. Example logs:
```
2024-08-05T06:14:22Z auth-service: introspect: token_kid=kj12abc expected_kid=kj34def
HTTP 401 /v1/toolcall -> {"error":"invalid_kid"}
stream connection closed by remote peer
```
priya: That smells like cached JWKS at the runtime/edge. Our JWKS cache is 5m, so a rotation can create a short window of mismatch.
sam: We should be able to evict the cache or restart the specific runner for the failing shard. Targeted restart is low risk.
priya: Agreed — eviction preferred if trivial. If not, restart.
mike: @oncall-bot can you run a restart for runner-17?
oncall-bot: infra-cli job queued: restart-runner --shard=runner-17 --env=hosted-smoke — ETA 30s.
elaine: Before restarting, can we rerun just the failing shard so release isn't blocked unnecessarily?
sam: I'll rerun shard 17 now.
ci-bot: Rerun issued: ci rerun --job=98765 --shard=17
sam: Rerun started — I'll watch for >10m red.
mike: Restart should be finishing now, watching logs.
ci-bot: Rerun 98765 completed: first two attempts had 401s then subsequent attempts succeeded after runner restart; timeline: 06:14 fail, 06:18 pass.
elaine: Looks like a short propagation window during the key rotation. Proposed immediate actions: 1) proceed with release since smoke is green, 2) follow-up infra changes — reduce JWKS TTL and add eviction tooling, 3) add a post-auth-rollout smoke-check to release playbook.
priya: I'll open a PR to reduce the JWKS TTL and an RFC for safe rotation procedure.
sam: I'll add an infra helper to evict JWKS and wire a CI smoke step post-rollout.
mike: For this release we can proceed but monitor auth errors in telemetry for the next hour. :thumbsup:
elaine: Agreed, proceeding with cut in 10m. Filing INF-1427 to track JWKS TTL + eviction work. Thanks all.
ci-bot: Ticket created: INF-1427
